scenario.name: r-cd-chained-depth-2
scenario.description: Depth-2 delegate chain: parent→child→grandchild→return path. Three sub-tests: (1) up-tree silent-wake, (2) inter-session return, (3) echo+broadcast via fanoutMode.

invocation.promptTemplate: Proof chain nonce {{nonce}}: you are depth-1. Fire your own continue_delegate(mode='silent-wake', task='Grandchild nonce {{nonce}}: reply GRANDCHILD-DONE and the nonce. Do not mutate files.'). Then reply CHILD-DONE and the nonce.

expectedReceipts.name: child-spawns
expectedReceipts.description: Post-dispatch, non-harness session event contains strict CHILD-DONE sentinel

expectedReceipts.name: child-fires-grandchild
expectedReceipts.description: CHILD-DONE sentinel confirms depth-1 delegate executed the nested continue_delegate instruction

expectedReceipts.name: grandchild-spawns
expectedReceipts.description: Post-dispatch, non-harness session event contains strict GRANDCHILD-DONE sentinel

expectedReceipts.name: grandchild-returns
expectedReceipts.description: GRANDCHILD-DONE sentinel observed after dispatch acceptance gate

expectedReceipts.name: parent-receives-chain-return
expectedReceipts.description: Parent session receives nonce-correlated, non-harness chained return evidence

expectedReceipts.name: trace-id
expectedReceipts.description: Trace ID for chain visualization in Tempo

review.notes: Depth-2 chain proof. PASS-candidate requires post-dispatch, non-harness CHILD-DONE and GRANDCHILD-DONE sentinels (strict evidence gate). Ignore prompt-echo events from the original [k6-proof-harness] instruction. Chain depth limit enforcement tested implicitly (depth-2 should succeed; gateway caps apply). tasks.list remains optional context because continue_delegate uses pending-delegate/subagent surfaces, not the generic task registry.

liveRunSafety.notes: Live depth-2 chain row. Prefer OPENCLAW_CREATE_DISPOSABLE_SESSION=true for repeatability so the proof does not touch the live #sprites/main Discord lane. Serialize per target session (sameSessionConcurrencySafe=false). Detector must ignore [k6-proof-harness] prompt echo; only post-dispatch sentinel evidence counts.
